Practically insoluble in water; soluble in al- cohol; freely soluble in dehydrated alcohol, in acetone, and in fatty oils. Protect from light. USP 31 (Vitamin E). A clear, yellow, or greenish-yellow, practi- cally odourless, viscous oil. It may solidify in the cold. It is stable to air and light, but unstable to alkali.
